Please read this before you travel
Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers should check their pet papers and crate plans before arriving, since small errors can slow boarding and cause stress for everyone. We are sorry for any hassle, but the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways has to follow safety rules closely for each animal.

<<FACT F070>> For rabbit travel, please use the approved crate guidance and make sure the carrier is secure, clean, and ready for inspection. <<FACT F057>> If you are bringing a larger dog, please review the fee details in advance so there are no surprises at the desk.

Our handlers use calm, humane care and will guide you through the process in plain words. If you need help, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure so we can check everything together.
